description: This file defines a class 'CompositeInput' within the 'device' namespace, which manages composite input functionality. It includes class methods for retrieving input status, selecting ports, and scaling video, along with related constants and include directives.

classes.name: CompositeInput
classes.description: Class managing COMPOSITE Input; provides interface to get input status, select ports, and scale video.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of CompositeInput.

methods.name: getNumberOfInputs
methods.description: Returns the number of COMPOSITE input sources.

methods.name: isPresented
methods.description: Checks if the composite input is presented.

methods.name: isActivePort
methods.description: Checks if the specified port is active.

methods.name: isPortConnected
methods.description: Checks if a given port is connected.

methods.name: scaleVideo
methods.description: Scales the video display to specified dimensions and position.
